target.title: fix(onboard): replace redundant dynamic import with static import of setup.shared
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`src/commands/onboard-guided.ts` uses a dynamic `await import()` to load `mergeWizardConfigOntoLatest` and `writeWizardConfigFile` from `../wizard/setup.shared.js`, even though the same module is already imported statically at the top of the file for `requireRiskAcknowledgement`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Node.js module cache ensures a second dynamic import of an already-loaded module returns the exact same module object — so the dynamic import is functionally a no-op that adds an unnecessary microtask and obscures the fact that these exports are already available. Adding them to the existing static import removes the indirection.

## User Impact

No user-visible impact. One fewer `await import()` during the config-update-recommendation path.

## Evidence

- `npm run typecheck` passes (no type errors from the relocated import).
